entities.name: CTP synthase candidate
observations: 534-aa sequence matches reviewed CTP synthases at ~60.4–60.8% identity and ~98% coverage, supporting a CTP synthase annotation by homology.
Predicted architecture: CTP_synth_N (PF06418; residues 7–269) and GATase (PF00117; residues 304–528); glutamine-dependent ammonia generation is consistent with CTP synthesis.

Reviewed homolog annotations assign EC 6.3.4.2 and de novo pyrimidine/CTP biosynthesis; homotetrameric assembly and GTP activation/CTP feedback inhibition are homolog-based, not demonstrated for this query.
Sequence-derived length 534 aa; calculated mass about 60.4 kDa.

entities.name: UTP to CTP synthesis
observations: Homolog-linked Rhea reaction: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+); Rhea:26426.
Alternative ammonia donor reaction reported: UTP + NH4(+) + ATP = CTP + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+); Rhea:16597.
